title: Transport of concrete presheaf pullback module instances
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be continuous, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $Y$ and $M$ a sheaf of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $f_p$ for presheaf left Kan extension along inverse image of opens, and $i$ for its unit [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. There exist module structures of $(f_pR)(U)$ on the actual abelian groups $(f_pM)(U)$ for all opens $U\subseteq X$ such that every restriction is semilinear and $i_M(rm)=i_R(r)i_M(m)$ on $f^{-1}V$ for all opens $V\subseteq Y$, $r\in R(V)$ and $m\in M(V)$.

source.place: Tag 008T, lemma-pullback-presheaf-module; transport of clause (1) of lem-pc-presheaf-module-inverse-image-adjunction along its recorded underlying abelian-presheaf isomorphism

proof.text: Apply PresheafOfModules.topologicalPullbackAdjunction to obtain a concrete module presheaf pullback functor P, a natural isomorphism of its underlying abelian presheaf with the Lan, and the coprojection scalar-product formula.

At each open take the inverse of the underlying abelian-presheaf isomorphism as an additive equivalence t from the Lan carrier to the P carrier. AddEquiv.module transports the section module structure. The formula t(r*m)=r*t(m), naturality of t, and the semilinearity of P restrictions show semilinearity of the transported restrictions, using injectivity of t.

At the inverse image of V, the coprojection formula from the first step has final restriction the identity. Apply injectivity of t and its scalar-product formula to obtain semilinearity of the Lan unit. This uses no nonemptiness hypothesis on V or its inverse image.
